svg.title: US and Hong Kong books, measured apart
svg.desc: Us Book +44.36%, +US$1,105 on US$2,491 (true_principal). Hk Book −51.79%, −HK$55,639 on HK$107,431 (net_principal). Combined −37.00% in USD (mixed). Each return is total P&L (realized + unrealized) divided by the basis named under it; the bases differ and the currencies are not added. Daily total P&L per book from 2026-06-22 to 2026-10-23. Source: dashboard.json on the data plane.
